== Summary ==
Slip, 9 January 2007: •You Want This, Don't You? (V), as printed on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 12 sheet (“Official text as of January 9, 2007”) for [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154830/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf] (swccgpc.com, PDF dated 10 January 2007; Internet Archive capture 24 October 2007), page 5, slip 43. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[You Want This, Don't You? (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates) (Original)|You Want This, Don't You? (V) (Virtual Set 12)]].
